findings.disposition_reason: lens-correctness round 2: test_a_small_sample_is_named (845c613) seeds security=3/correctness=12 findings and asserts the caveat names security, not correctness; red on c1da60c, green on HEAD.
findings.message: The suite's only `aegis metrics` invocation runs on a fixture with zero task reviews, so the caveat's positive branch (shown when a lens has fewer than ten judged findings) is never exercised, only the vacuous negative one. A regression that dropped the caveat entirely or moved the `< 10` threshold would still pass this test.
findings.minimal_fix: Seed one lens record with e.g. 3 findings before calling metrics, and assert the caveat names that lens.

findings.disposition_reason: lens-correctness round 3: Scratch repo, core.fileMode=false: digest constant across chmod 644→755; default (tracked) repo still moves it — fix matches content_key's gating, 290/290 tests pass.
findings.message: diff_digest hashes the local exec bit unconditionally, but content_key/review_snapshot gate the same bit on file_mode_tracked(ctx), so on a core.fileMode=false checkout the digest still varies with the local exec bit even though git doesn't track it there. Demonstrated in a scratch repo: identical content under core.fileMode=false, digest differs between local modes 0644 and 0755 — the same checkout-dependence R-40 exists to close, for that config.
findings.minimal_fix: Gate the marker like content_key does: 'x' if file_mode_tracked(ctx) and stat.st_mode & 0o100 else '-'.
